answer: Anchor each identity to one signed smart-meter reading from a real power feed: every epoch an agent submits its utility meter's fresh signed consumption proof, like a raven carrying a single black onyx token home. A lone agent's meter is its own. A farm's clones all drink from one datacenter feed, so their readings collapse into one identity, and renting a separate metered premise per fake — letting each wander the grid alone — costs far more than the reward.
